name: Gui Hua Xiang
parentage: One of the ten traditional fragrance types, selected from the native Phoenix Mountain population.
description: 'Osmanthus Fragrance'. A classic and beloved Phoenix Dan Cong oolong fragrance type. It is celebrated for its delicate, elegant, and very clear aroma of sweet osmanthus flowers. It is less overwhelmingly powerful than Mi Lan Xiang, offering a more refined and purely floral experience.
plantType: Medium-sized Dan Cong arbor (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Grows in the high-altitude, misty environment of the Phoenix Mountains, which allows for the slow development of its delicate aromatic compounds.
